* Current-biased five-transistor OTA  (SKY130 1.8 V core devices)

*     the mirror-node pole down into the loop-gain crossover region.
*   - The external 50 uA flows into ibias and is sunk by the XMB diode.
*
* SKY130 MOS wrapper terminal order is drain gate source bulk.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt ota_5t vss ibias vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* ota_5t : five-transistor OTA (SKY130 1.8 V core devices)
*
*   Differential input stage : XM1/XM2  NMOS pair, tail-biased, vinp on the
*                              mirror-diode side and vinn on the output side
*                              so that vout = A*(vinp-vinn).
*   Active-load stage        : XML1/XML2 PMOS current mirror; XML1 is the
*                              diode-connected leg, XML2 delivers the mirrored
*                              half-current into the single-ended output.
*   Biasing stage            : XMB diode accepts the 50 uA external reference
*                              at ibias; XMTAIL mirrors it 130/43 ~= 3.0x to
*                              set the ~150 uA tail current.
*
* Sizing rationale (1 pF load, VDD 1.62-1.98 V, VICM = VDD/2, -40..125 C):
*   - NMOS input pair, because a 0.81 V input common mode at VDD = 1.62 V
*     leaves no room for a PMOS pair source (|Vth_p| ~ 0.9 V in this PDK).
*   - W/L = 160/1.1 puts the pair in moderate inversion (gm/Id ~ 18 /V), so a
*     ~1.3 mS gm meets UGB = gm/(2*pi*Cload) >= 100 MHz, while L = 1.1 um
*     keeps ro high enough for >= 40 dB loop gain; the pair area also puts the
*     1/f noise corner low enough for the 50 uVrms (10 Hz-10 MHz) budget.
*   - Load mirror at L = 1.1 um contributes only ~1/3 of the output
*     conductance; W = 57 um keeps |Vgs_p| low so the natural open-loop output
*     sits near mid-supply, which is where CMRR/PSRR are measured.
*   - Tail W = 130 um keeps Vdsat_tail below the ~0.15 V available at
*     VDD = 1.62 V, cold, so the tail stays saturated (current stability
*     and CMRR) at every corner.
*   scale = 1u: l and w are micrometres, w/nf is the per-finger width.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt ota_5t vss ibias vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---- biasing stage --------------------------------------------------------
XMB    ibias ibias vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=43  nf=9
XMTAIL ntail ibias vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=130 nf=26

* ---- differential input stage ---------------------------------------------
XM1    nd    vinp  ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.1 w=160 nf=32
XM2    vout  vinn  ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.1 w=160 nf=32

* ---- active-load stage ----------------------------------------------------
XML1   nd    nd    vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.1 w=57  nf=12
XML2   vout  nd    vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.1 w=57  nf=12

.ends ota_5t

* Five-transistor OTA (differential pair + current-mirror active load + tail bias)
* Sky130 core devices, 1.62-1.98 V supply, 1 pF load, 50 uA external reference.
*
* Biasing stage : XMB sinks the 50 uA forced into ibias and mirrors it 50:14
*                 (identical 3 um wide, 2 um long fingers) into the tail XM5.
* Input stage   : XM1/XM2 nfet_01v8, L = 1 um for output resistance, W = 160 um
*                 for gm/Id ~ 19 (gm ~ 1.6 mS at 89 uA/side -> UGB > 110 MHz into
*                 1 pF and input-referred noise ~ 32 uVrms over 10 Hz-10 MHz).
*                 Regular-Vt nfets give about twice the Early voltage of the lvt
*                 flavour, and that is what sets the 1 kHz loop gain.
* Active load   : XM3/XM4 pfet_01v8_lvt, L = 2.25 um. The low-Vt flavour runs at
*                 |Vgs| ~ 0.9 V in strong inversion, so gm3 << gm1 (small noise
*                 contribution) while the natural open-loop output, vdd - |Vgs3|,
*                 stays near mid-supply and keeps XM2/XM4 saturated at the bias
*                 point used for the open-loop CMRR/PSRR measurements.

.subckt ota_5t vss ibias vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---- biasing stage: diode reference and 3.57x tail mirror ----
XMB ibias ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=42 nf=14
XM5 vtail ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=150 nf=50
* ---- differential input stage ----

XM2 vout vinn vtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=160 nf=40
* ---- active-load stage: pmos current mirror, vmir is the mirror node ----
XM3 vmir vmir vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.25 w=50 nf=25
XM4 vout vmir vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.25 w=50 nf=25
.ends ota_5t

* Current-biased five-transistor OTA (SKY130)
*
* Biasing stage : XMB  diode-connected NMOS sinking the 50 uA reference at ibias
* Tail          : XMT  NMOS mirror of XMB, 28:8 = 3.5x -> ~175 uA tail
* Input stage   : XM1 (vinp, diode side) / XM2 (vinn, output side) NMOS pair
* Active load   : XM3 (diode) / XM4 PMOS current mirror, single-ended output
*
* Sizing notes
* - Pair (W/L ~ 109) runs at gm/Id ~ 15-22 for UGB and low thermal noise;
*   L = 1.1 um sits near the peak NMOS intrinsic gain and gives enough gate
*   area for 1/f noise without loading vout with excess input capacitance.
* - Load L = 1.2 um keeps the PMOS gds well below the pair's gds (DC gain)
*   while keeping the mirror pole high enough for the unity-gain frequency
*   and phase margin of the true (loaded) loop, not only the injection metric.
* - Wide L = 1.1 um tail/bias devices keep the tail saturated with ~0.1-0.2 V
*   of headroom at VDD = 1.62 V (CMRR, PSRR-).
* - Every finger keeps w >= 7 um so the model bin chosen from w matches w/nf,
*   and no L sits on a model-bin boundary (1 um, 2 um).

.subckt ota_5t vss ibias vdd vinn vinp vout
XMB ibias ibias vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.1 w=10 nf=1 m=8
XMT tail  ibias vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.1 w=10 nf=1 m=28

* Current-biased five-transistor OTA (Sky130)
* Topology: NMOS differential input pair, PMOS current-mirror active
* load, NMOS tail current source mirrored from the external ibias reference.
* The input pair is operated in weak inversion for a PVT-robust transconductance
* (gm ~ Id / n*VT) and high intrinsic gain; large W*L lowers flicker noise.
* The PMOS load is sized to keep the mirror-node pole well above the unity-gain
* frequency while preserving output-headroom at the lowest supply corner.
.subckt ota_5t vss ibias vdd vinn vinp vout
* Biasing stage: diode-connected NMOS sinks the 50uA reference, setting the
* gate bias replicated by the tail current source M5.
XMB ibias ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=2
* Tail current source (mirror of reference).
XM5 ntail ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8.5 nf=9
* Differential input pair.
XM1 na vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=40
XM2 vout vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=40
* PMOS active-load current mirror.
XM3 na na vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=24 nf=5
XM4 vout na vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=24 nf=5
.ends ota_5t

* Five-transistor OTA (current-biased), SKY130
*   differential NFET input pair (low-Vt for VDD/2 input CM),
*   self-biased cascoded PMOS mirror active load,
*   NFET mirror of the external 50 uA reference for the tail current.
.subckt ota_5t vss ibias vdd vinn vinp vout
*
* ---- bias reference: 50 uA into a diode-connected NFET ----
XMB ibias ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=52 nf=8
* ---- tail current source (mirror of the reference) ----
XM0 stail ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=178 nf=16
* ---- differential input pair (low-Vt NFET for VDD/2 input CM headroom) ----
XM1 n1 vinp stail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=64 nf=8
XM2 vout vinn stail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=64 nf=8
* ---- self-biased cascoded PMOS mirror load ----
XM3C x x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=43 nf=4
XM4C p x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=43 nf=4
XM3 n1 n1 x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=45 nf=4
XM4 vout n1 p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=45 nf=4
.ends ota_5t

* The reference device is diode-connected at ibias.  The larger copy
* establishes the tail current while the remaining four devices form the

XMTAIL ntail ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=32.8 nf=8
XM1 n1 vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=160.0 nf=40
XM2 vout vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=160.0 nf=40
XM3 n1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=120.0 nf=30
XM4 vout n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=120.0 nf=30
.ends ota_5t

.subckt ota_5t vss ibias vdd vinn vinp vout
* Bias current mirror and differential input stage.
XMB ibias ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.4 w=16 nf=2
XMT tail ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.4 w=48 nf=2
XM1 nleft vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=64 nf=2
XM2 vout vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=64 nf=2

* PMOS current-mirror active load.

XMP2 vout nleft vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=64 nf=2
.ends ota_5t

.subckt ota_5t vss ibias vdd vinn vinp vout
* Differential-input front end with PMOS tail and NMOS mirror load.
XTAIL  ptail pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=280.0 nf=40
XMIN   n1    vinp  ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=224.0 nf=32
XMIP   nref  vinn  ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=224.0 nf=32
XML    nref  nref  vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=14.0 nf=2

XMN2   vout  n1    vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10.0 nf=2
XMP2   vout  pbias vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=14.0 nf=2
XRZ    n1    ncc   vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=12
XCC    ncc   vout  sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=16 l=25

* Bias generation from the only external analog-bias port.
XBIAS  ibias ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=112.0 nf=16
XBNP   pbias ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=8.0 nf=2
XBPREF pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=8.0 nf=2
.ends ota_5t

* Differential-input, single-ended-output five-transistor OTA (SKY130 1.8 V core)
*
*   Biasing stage : XM0 is the diode-connected reference device that sets the
*   gate bias from the external 50 uA reference on `ibias`; XM5 mirrors it into
*   the tail node.  Both run at low overdrive so the tail sink stays saturated.
*
*   Input stage   : XM1/XM2 NMOS differential pair with sources at `tail`.
*   Active load   : XM3/XM4 PMOS low-threshold current mirror, XM3 diode-connected.
*
*   vinn gates XM1 whose drain is vout, so the DC unity feedback vout -> vinn
*   closes a negative loop; vinp gates XM2 which drives the diode load XM3.
*
*                 vdd
*          +--------+----------+
*          |        |          |
*         XM3     XM4          |
*       (diode)     |          |
*          nd       +-- vout   |
*          |            |      |
*         XM2        XM1       |
*         vinp       vinn      |
*          +-----+-----+       |
*              tail            |
*                |             |
*              XM5          XM0 <-- ibias (50 uA reference branch)
*                |             |
*               vss           vss

.subckt ota_5t vss ibias vdd vinn vinp vout
* --- biasing stage: reference branch + tail current sink ---
XM0 ibias ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=32
XM5 tail   ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=720 nf=32
* --- differential input stage ---
XM1 vout vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=160 nf=32
XM2 nd   vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=160 nf=32
* --- PMOS current-mirror active load ---
XM3 nd   nd   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=32 nf=8
XM4 vout nd   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=32 nf=8
.ends ota_5t

* Five-transistor OTA: LVT NMOS differential pair (XM1/XM2), LVT PMOS
* current-mirror active load (XM3/XM4), and NMOS tail current mirror
* (XM0/XM5) biased from the external 50 uA ibias reference.
* Cascoded mirror/pair branches (XM3C/XM4C, XM1C/XM2C) raise the DC gain;
* XM8/XM9 generate the PMOS cascode bias vbp, XM13/XM14 generate the NMOS
* cascode bias vbn referenced to the tail node.

.subckt ota_5t vss ibias vdd vinn vinp vout
XM0 ibias ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4 m=2
XM5 ntail ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4 m=5
* vbp generator
XM8 vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=5 nf=1
XM9 vbp vbp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4

* nmos cascodes
XM1C nd1 vbn n1c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=30 nf=6
XM2C vout vbn n2c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=30 nf=6
* pmos mirror + cascodes

XM3C nd1 vbp na vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XM4 nb nd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* tail) with a cascoded input pair for gain and a stacked-diode bias branch.
* The 50 uA reference on ibias is stacked through two diode NMOS: node ibias
